confidence_notes: Low overall: no Dambulla-specific price data was found. Food and drink anchors use aggregated Colombo and Kolonnawa figures (Numbeo and cost-of-living guides, some dated 2023-2024 and many undated) with a smaller-town adjustment, and sources conflict widely. Recent beer excise increases may not be reflected in older sources. Cocktail and wine_glass are set from the local beer relationship (about 2.4x and 2.6x beer) because venue evidence is sparse and upscale. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates; no accommodation search was run. FX is stale: the newest RBA observation found by search is 2026-03-20 (0.7088 USD per AUD), and no later RBA figure could be confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink based on Colombo and Kolonnawa (Sri Lanka) aggregated price data, adjusted down for Dambulla, a smaller town in Matale District with tourist-facing restaurants. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for Cultural Triangle lodging (Dambulla, Sigiriya and Habarana area) from general knowledge only.
